positioning: Open-source dashboard combining self-hosted QA tooling with automated security scanning for teams wanting full data control
coreFeatures: Aggregates self-hosted QA tools (test runners, CI/CD, reporting) via awesome-selfhosted
Integrates Go-based security scanners from awesome-go for SAST/DAST/dependency checks
Exposes MCP server endpoints for AI-driven test orchestration and vulnerability triage
differentiators: Fully self-hosted, no SaaS data egress
Modular plugin architecture using MCP for extensibility
Unified QA + security view in single pane
mvpBuildPlan: Deploy awesome-selfhosted stack (Gitea, Drone, Grafana) on local k3s
Wire Go security scanners (gosec, nuclei, trivy) into CI pipelines
Implement MCP server wrapper for test triggering and result querying
risks: Integration complexity across heterogeneous self-hosted tools
Maintenance burden of multiple upstream projects
Limited enterprise support vs commercial platforms
valueProposition: Matching candidates with relevant Full Stack and Cybersecurity experience to client roles
